properties.notes: Part of a Floodzone 2. Townhouses under construction and building work started on conversioin of the old Switchgear factory.. Redevelopment of parcels of land making up the overall former Cuttler Hammer factory site and Tumbling Weir hotel car park. Comprising conversion of building to30 apartments, construction of 33 new dwellings and construction of 29 retirement apartments. West part of site substantially complete but factory site in progress and Tumbling Weir car park not started construction..
